rules.reason: ADR-010 D2 item 2: the Liquid engine imports no other internal package and nothing outside the standard library, so it is testable against Golden Liquid with no METAIS concept in scope
ADR-007 D4 item 1: the split-run scan does not depend on the manifest, so it runs before a container is wired up

ADR-009 A2 item 4: the binary never reaches the release builder, which is why the builder may run commands, read the environment and write files; ADR-009 A8 item 3: nor the UX runner, which is why the runner may start sessions, read the environment, write files and read the clock
ADR-010 D2 item 2, PRD R2 item 1: browse reaches hostfs only through extract's single entry point, so listing, reading and searching cannot write

ADR-009 D7, ADR-010 D2 item 2: the inputs layer reaches the host only to read the data directory, through hostfs's read side in its single entry point, so no other path of the layer can open a host file or write one
ADR-010 A7 item 11, D2 item 2: internal/render reaches hostfs only through CheckPaths, so no form, producer or stage can touch the host, and only internal/render/sink writes
ADR-009 A5 item 4: metais skill writes the host from nothing but the binary's own text and version, so no code that reads a package or an input is in its closure

ADR-009 A5 items 2 and 4: the skill package reaches the host only through Install, which reads and writes the two fixed skill paths beneath the directory its caller names

ADR-010 D2 item 2: pkgtreetest is a test-only helper package, an importable package only so that other packages' tests can build a package in memory and hold a Tree to its contract; no release code imports it
ADR-011 D17 item 3: the liquid-spec JSON-RPC server is a test-only program, its test binary run with -serve, and no release code links it
ADR-011 D16 item 5: vectorgen is the program that produces the suite's committed packages, with its reproduction test; it holds no release code, and nothing imports it
ADR-010 D2 item 2, D11 item 8: hostenv is the one judge of whether a stream is a terminal
ADR-010 D2 item 2, D11 item 3: hostfs alone uses x/sys, for the no-replace rename

ADR-010 D11 item 1, ADR-001 D8 item 6: archive/zip is never used for reading: a package is read by zipfmt's own reader, and only zipfmt's tests import archive/zip, to compare its writer with CreateRaw (zipfmt's TestNoArchiveZip holds its release files to that)
ADR-010 D11 item 7, RULINGS R1-023: normalization and case folding are unitext's, which holds the one portable-path predicate, so no second one can be built beside it
ADR-010 D6 item 5: one implementation of the YAML profile serves the manifest, YAML inputs and frontmatter, so no second package reads YAML around it
ADR-010 D2, ADR-007 D2 and D3: the cross-reference is check's, which internal/author holds, so no other command or layer reports template.xref.* findings around it

ADR-010 D10 item 2, ADR-007 D9 item 18: regexprofile translates and parses every pattern, and the sample generator walks the tree regexprofile parsed, which is the tree the validator matches with, never a parse of its own
ADR-010 D2, ADR-008 D9: the authoring commands' work is reached only through their declarations in the command table, so init, check, test, pack and unpack each have one entry from the command line

ADR-009 A6 item 6: the memory backstop alone reads the runtime's memory, and the figure goes nowhere but its comparison with the ceiling, so no other code can carry a measure of the host into a finding or an output (D15)
ADR-009 A6 item 6: the memory backstop alone sets the runtime's soft memory limit, to 1 GiB, beside the ceiling it watches
ADR-009 A6 item 6: the backstop runs the command cmd/metais runs, and nothing else
ADR-009 A6 item 6: the backstop wraps the process's one command in Main, the entry cmd/metais calls; Run, which tests drive in-process, runs no backstop

ADR-010 D2 item 2, ADR-009 D14 item 4: everything else receives the arguments and streams, so the whole tool runs in-process under test; ADR-009 A2 item 5: the release builder is a main package run with go run; ADR-009 A8 item 1: so is the UX runner
